title: PART 4 / CHEW ON THIS
goal: Use story evidence and shared experiences to explore different perspectives, respond to conflict, and strengthen teamwork.
outcomes: Compare perspectives and responses to conflict.
Identify qualities of a strong teammate.
focus: Encourage students to consider different perspectives and support their thinking with evidence.
assessment: Team Talk: Listen for explanations supported by story evidence. Conflict Scenarios: Look for respectful responses that consider different perspectives.

rows.description: Select three prompts and display them.

rows.text: Students discuss in pairs or small groups, using story evidence to support their ideas.
Slides 2–6 — Introduce the four scenarios and assign one to each group.
Groups consider different perspectives, agree on a respectful response, and share briefly.
What would an assertive response sound like?
Slide 7 — Revisit Maddie’s changing perspective on Leila.

source_note: Draft revision 2026-11-04: Team Talk opens with Slide 1, no Wrap-Up; print-pack in Preparation; role-play separate MORE resource; Bulletin Board as optional SHOW/DO/MORE; small slips six per page. All slides numbered locally 1–8.

bonus_rows.text: Slide 8 — Introduce the Graffiti Wall (5–10 min).
Students complete “A strong teammate is someone who…” and display their responses together.
